description: Perform an HTTP PUT. Use for full-resource replacement. Idempotent: the same PUT applied twice leaves the resource in the same state.

allow_private_hosts.description: Allow loopback / private / link-local targets for this call (default false). Refused unless the server operator launched fetch-mcp with FETCH_MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS=1 -- SSRF protection stays on by default either way.

bearer_token.description: Bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>

body.description: Raw request body as a string

body_json.description: Request body as a JSON value — sets content-type to application/json if none given

content_type.description: Content-Type header to send with the body (e.g. application/json, text/plain, application/x-www-form-urlencoded)

decode_text.description: Force text decoding (true) or binary base64 (false). Defaults to auto — text for text/*, json, xml, etc; binary otherwise.

headers.description: Extra request headers as a key/value object

max_bytes.description: Max response body size in bytes before the body is truncated (default 5MiB, ceiling 100MiB)

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in ms for each attempt, covering DNS, every redirect hop and the body (default 10000, max 120000). Retries get a fresh budget; a whole call is capped at 5 minutes.

name: http_put
